name: WEC ENERGY GROUP, INC.
base_source: TTM adjusted EPS: FY2025 adjusted $5.27 - H1 2025 $3.02 + H1 2026 $3.36 = $5.61/share; cross-checked TTM GAAP EPS $5.15 (NI to common $1,557.5M - $969.6M + $1,103.6M = $1,691.5M), gap is exactly the $0.46 Q4 2025 QIP/UEA settlement charge. Engine normalized base rejected: conservative OE (OCF - total capex) is negative in FY2025 (-$3.15/sh) and TTM (-$1,373.3M: OCF $3,574.2M - capex $4,947.5M from EDGAR 10-Q YTD) — structural for a rate-base-growing utility, not earning power. See analysis.md.
moat_justification: Legal monopoly electric/gas franchises in WI/IL/MI/MN with an all-regulated $37.5B 2026-2030 capital plan, PSCW-approved very-large-customer tariff shifting data-center credit risk to those customers, 22 straight years of meeting/beating guidance and 23 straight dividend increases, plus I-94 corridor data-center load growth — against regulator-capped allowed ROE (Illinois disallowances and the $205M QIP/UEA settlement), $5.3-5.7B of planned equity issuance diluting per-share growth, debt-funded expansion, and long-run gas-network electrification risk.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share -3.15 vs 3-yr median 1.36 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 11.0x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
one_liner: Regulated Midwest monopoly with a real data-center growth runway, moat 6/10 — but at $104.91 (18.7x TTM adjusted earnings of $5.61/share) it yields only a 9.2% weighted IRR with IV@15% of $55.02; it clears the 15% hurdle only at ~$55, or ~$44 with a margin of safety, and even the super-bull case ($75.20) sits below today's price.
